content:
An off-duty U.S. Border Patrol agent was arrested in Laredo after police allegedly found him drinking alcohol with minors in a hotel parking lot, according to KGNS.

Laredo police responded around 5:35 p.m. on Sunday, November 1, to the 2400 block of East Del Mar Boulevard after a report of a man drinking alcohol with minors. According to KGNS, officers found 34-year-old Jose Daniel Alvarez with minors, including teenagers in the parking lot and in his vehicle.

Alvarez was arrested on charges including driving while intoxicated with a child under 15 and furnishing alcohol to a minor, according to KGNS. He was booked into the Webb County Jail. U.S. Customs and Border Protection was reported as aware of the arrest and cooperating with local authorities.

The Laredo Morning Times also reported the arrest on a charge of furnishing alcohol to minors. Alvarez has been charged, not convicted, and is presumed innocent unless proven guilty in court.
